brief:
Hamas official Abdel Hakeem Hanini said Wednesday that Israeli demolition of prisoners' homes and systematic arrests in the West Bank amount to a reprisal policy that will not break Palestinian resolve, Shehab Wire reported. Hanini characterized the operations as attempts to suppress resistance activity and Palestinian steadfastness.

The statement came as Israeli forces have intensified operations across the occupied territory, targeting homes of Palestinians accused of militant activity and carrying out mass arrests.

title: Hamas says Israel's demolitions and arrests won't break Palestinian resistance
